# Session 15 Research

- The product requirements define PASS@1 as trial-level success and require
  separate Enterprise Score reporting.
- Enterprise Score is task-equal: average attempts within each task, then
  average tasks.
- A regression-free attempt scores 80 points from new-test coverage and 20
  points from a full pass; regressions score zero.
- Missing, invalid, partial, and zero measurements must remain distinguishable.
